messages:
sara: Heads-up — deploybot reported a push backoff to ECR for image redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 at 1766012345. Canary didn't start.
matt: Noted. Any error logs from deploybot? 429s or auth? :thinking_face:
deploybot: [deploybot] push start -> https://ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/…/redwood/runtime:v2.3.1
deploybot: [deploybot] response: 429 TooManyRequests, Retry-After: 12
ci-bot: Build succeeded and provenance attestation generated: sha256:abcdef1234
ana: Ugh rate-limit. Is this a burst from parallel CI pushes or a regional ECR throttling?
ana: We had a spike from image-builder in eu-west-1 earlier, but this is us-west-2. Could be cross-region mirror traffic.
oncall: I'm seeing elevated PutImage API errors in CW logs starting 1766012338. 429s then a 503 from mirror proxy at 1766012355.
sara: Canary remains in HOLD. Releasing would risk inconsistent manifests across regions. Suggest we pause billboard rollout and pin existing canary to digest for safe rollback.
matt: Agreed. Plan: abort current canary, mark v2.3.1 as "publish-pending" and fallback to v2.3.0 pinned digest. I'll open the release-note edit.
ana: Quick checklist — should we retag locally and push to a different repo name as temporary? That will break provenance lineage. Prefer wait 10–15m for backoff unless we need urgent deploy.
deploybot: [deploybot] attempted retry schedule: delays = [12s, 24s, 48s], attempts = 3. Final state: backoff-failed -> halted by orchestration policy.
sara: We need decision: (A) wait for ECR quota to recover and resume, (B) force-push to a staging repo (loses provenance continuity), (C) rollback to v2.3.0 pinned digest now. Vote?
matt: Vote C. App owner confirmed no critical bug that requires v2.3.1 immediate rollout.
ana: Vote C unless oncall sees a short window to safely retry.
oncall: I'll keep watch. If error rate drops below 5% by 1766012385 I'll greenlight a retry, otherwise rollback. I'll post updates.
ci-bot: Release note update: "Canary paused due to ECR rate limit. Rolling back to v2.3.0 digest for stability. Investigating publish retry." (edited by matt)
sara: OK—matt, please initiate rollback & add changelog entry. oncall, ping once CW shows recovery and we can requeue publish.
matt: Starting rollback now: running deploybot abort + pin route to digest `sha256:1234deadbeef`.
matt: Command: ```
# abort canary
deploybot abort --id canary-2026-03-20-01
# pin service route
redwoodctl route set --service runtime --image-digest sha256:1234deadbeef --force
```
deploybot: [deploybot] abort acknowledged, canary abort in progress.
oncall: CW looks marginally better at 1766012398 (PutImage 429 -> 200 for a short stretch) but still spiky. Hold off on republish until sustained 2m of healthy logs.
sara: Closing thread — rollback in progress, publishing blocked by ECR 429s. Follow-up: infra to request ECR quota bump / coordinate mirror traffic to smooth bursts. :white_check_mark:
